title: Pennsieve Application Manifest
description: Declarative manifest (app.yml) committed to an application's source repository. Pennsieve reads this file when the repository is published to the App Store to seed the application's runtime configuration, parameters, inputs/outputs, and classification.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete and validation. In app.yml this is normally expressed as a `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` directive comment rather than a key.

application.description: Application metadata. This is where name, description and type belong.

id.description: Stable identifier, normally the repository name.

description.description: Short description of what the application does.

type.description: Role the application plays within a workflow.

runtime.description: Where and how the application executes, and the cpu/memory it starts from. These are defaults; workspace runs may override within allowed limits.

computeTypes.description: Compute environments the application supports. A GPU application lists "gpu" here; there is no separate gpu block.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum run time before the application is stopped.

gpu.description: Deprecated: add "gpu" to computeTypes instead. Read as computeTypes: [gpu].

resources.description: Deprecated: put cpu and memory on runtime instead.

parameters.description: Run-time parameters exposed to users. The default of each parameter pre-populates the workflow run form.

inputs.description: Typed input ports. Used to validate connections when the application is placed in a workflow.

outputs.description: Typed output ports. Used to validate connections to downstream applications.

categories.description: Curated categories used to group and discover applications.

tags.description: Free-form labels for search and filtering.

name.description: Machine name passed to the application. Must be unique within the manifest.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the run form.

description.description: Help text shown beneath the field.

type.description: Parameter data type. Determines the control rendered in the UI. Prefer "string" with validValues over "enum", which is kept for older manifests.

defaultValue.description: Value used to pre-populate the run form, written as a string. A parameter with no defaultValue is treated as required.

validValues.description: Permitted values. Renders the parameter as a dropdown, whatever its declared type.

required.description: Only needed to contradict what defaultValue implies: without a defaultValue a parameter is required, with one it is not.

name.description: Port name. Must be unique among the application's inputs (or outputs).

dataType.description: Data type carried by the port: a Pennsieve package type, or "any" to match everything. The available package types are served by GET /packages/types, so this is not a fixed list. Used to validate workflow connections.

required.description: Whether the port must be connected for the application to run (inputs only).
